summary.title: Stand up from the deepest crouch in 1 s and hold

verdict.what: holds 300 +- 10 mm
follows the prediction within 15 mm
peak motor torque <= 18 N m
no oscillation over 5 mm peak to peak in the hold
load plate 120-170 N steady (14.75 kg carried: about 145 N)
VBUS inside 32-45 V

summary.title: Three squats, 300 to 150 mm at 0.5 Hz

verdict.what: follows the prediction within 15 mm (the model is right)
tracks the command within 35 mm (the VMC lags a 0.5 Hz squat by design: 26 mm predicted)
peak motor torque <= 18 N m
VBUS under 45 V (regeneration)

summary.title: Crouch, push off at the 60 N m cap, tuck in the air, land

verdict.what: the push and the flight follow the prediction within 20 mm (to the landing)
jump height 200-320 mm
motor torque feedback <= 70 N m
settles to 250 +- 15 mm within 0.5 s of landing
VBUS inside 28-45 V (a push sags it, the tuck and landing lift it)

summary.title: Dropped with the wheel 150 mm off the floor, the leg holding 300 mm

verdict.what: motor torque feedback <= 55 N m
back to 300 +- 10 mm within 0.5 s of touching down
the dip within 20 % of the prediction
